meta.prompt: Using Denodo view admin.pg_vessel_positions_select, for IMO 9282792 (CLYDE NOBLE), retrieve one row per UTC calendar date with AIS records after '2025-05-15 00:00:00' UTC. Include vesselname, imonumber, ais_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MIN(timestamp_date) AS first_ts_on_date, MAX(timestamp_date) AS last_ts_on_date. Group by vesselname, imonumber, ais_date.
